browserAccessAudit.kind: Numeric and fixed-metadata projection from the bounded posthoc audit
browserAccessAudit.limitation: Both statuses are no_clear_bypass_observed. This is not proof of adherence or an operating-system hard fence. Transitive imports and unobserved executions are not established.
browserAccessAudit.activityScope: Audit tool-execution counts measure audit coverage, not complete comparable tool-payload or model-token activity. An empty runtime tool inventory is missing evidence, not evidence of zero tool use.

comparison.denominator: Codex complete episode; both are normal completed first submissions without repair
comparison.qualityComparison: Equal recorded total scores of 47/48, with different dimension scores and material findings
comparison.conclusion: Both first submissions pass all 26 independent checks and tie at 47/48 in bounded blinded static review. Vector costs 0.657099% more and uses 1.579125% more agent wall time. This pair does not meet the cost target or establish the full candidate quality decision.

qualityPriority.rule: No lower quality on any task; a stronger task cannot offset a weaker one. Cost is secondary.
qualityPriority.overallCandidateDecision: Pending completion and task-by-task quality assessment of all three tasks; no overall decision before the third task.

blindedCodeReview.method: Blinded static exact-source review and two supplied independent end-state screenshots per submission

vector.description: Added HTTP tests invoke createHandler directly and represent restart by reopening the store. They do not launch/restart the direct Bun.serve process, exercise built static serving, or cover browser workflows.
vector.interpretation: Missing authored coverage, not an established failure of those behaviors.

codex.description: Source/title validation traverses whole strings and materializes scalar arrays before rejecting fields beyond 200 scalars. Oversized valid-Unicode short fields can amplify transient memory and synchronous work under the 1 GiB raw request allowance.
codex.interpretation: Static risk; no memory exhaustion or latency failure was measured.

limits: Neither reviewer independently executed an application, test, build, browser action, network request, or restart. Authored reports and scripts are source evidence, not independent execution results.
Two end-state screenshots per app show search/pagination only, leaving importer feedback, stale restart, document history, citation details and cited-version opening source-assessed.
Both apps buffer requests up to a 1 GiB raw limit; large-input load, concurrency, races, assistive technology, complete keyboard flows and process restarts were not independently observed.

If every matching body token exceeds 512 bytes, the whole-token requirement and 512-byte excerpt cap conflict. No separate exact-byte citation binding defect was established from that contradictory edge.
blindedCodeReview.limitation: Neither review established a critical finding. Equal bounded static totals with different findings are not a guarantee of exact quality equivalence or production security, reliability, or usability.

accountingCheckpoint.scope: Historical checkpoint at settlement of this completed Evidence Workbench pair
accountingCheckpoint.note: These historical totals exclude later activity and do not report the current study bill.

publication.note: Only the eight explicitly inventoried generated Codex artifacts are excluded; their exact paths, hashes and bytes remain in the manifest. Authored ignored verification files remain included. Git-index verification awaits repository-owner staging.
